arrangement.notes: Sample-based arrangement featuring a textured bed with layered one-shot hits providing dynamic emotional expression following a cinematic rise and fall energy profile. Channel names correspond to sample slicing techniques.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Elevate energy with fuller drum hits and intensified one-shot layering.

event_markers.label: Bridge FX Rise
event_markers.reason: Introduce risefall FX to highlight emotional shift before final hook.

event_markers.label: Outro Start
event_markers.reason: Gradual decrease in drum activity for cinematic fade out.

track_roles.drums: provide the rhythmic foundation with slice-based drum samples and dynamic one-shot hits
track_roles.bass: support groove with sample-based bass layer
track_roles.chords: add harmonic texture with pad and keyboard sample slices
track_roles.melody: offer emotional lead elements using one-shot melody and lead hits
track_roles.fx: enhance transitions and dynamics using risefall and impact FX samples

sensei_drum.brief: Create and control drum patterns based on sliced samples, managing energy and texture layers with one-shot hits for emotional dynamic range.

bass_generator.brief: Generate smooth sample-based bass lines that complement the boom bap groove and support the cinematic energy curve.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chordal textures using sample slices to create an emotional and atmospheric background layer.

melody_generator.brief: Design melodic one-shot hits and lead fragments for emotional expression without using continuous notes.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement pacing and ensure the cinematic rise and fall energy profile is maintained across sections.

presetor.brief: Manage sample selection and ensure channel naming conventions reflect slicing and one-shot techniques.

songgps.brief: Guide structural arrangement according to mainstream boom bap form with emotional mood and varying energy levels.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio for mixing while preserving the raw dynamic and cinematic energy transitions.
